grounding.label: FAIL
grounding.explanation: The app_crash answer is fully supported (build 7.9.3 fix_available, install channel, reopen-and-check next steps). The billing answer fails: it asserts a $300.90 USD charge that appears only in the corrupted observed record (authoritative amount is $29.99 USD), and it states the refund cannot be confirmed even though the authoritative record establishes refund_issued. Agreement with observed_records is not proof of correctness, and the supported refund state is contradicted rather than reported.

answer_excerpts.quote: I see the report of a $300.90 USD charge after your cancellation, but our record for this is contradictory and unverified, so I can't confirm whether a refund was actually issued.

coverage.label: FAIL
coverage.explanation: The app_crash answer includes the needed conclusion (fix available in build 7.9.3) and supported next steps (install via existing channel, reopen Settings, report back if it persists). The billing answer omits the necessary conclusion that the authoritative record establishes: a $29.99 USD post-cancellation charge was refunded. Instead it leaves the outcome unconfirmed and asks the customer for verification data, so the required answer content is missing.

omissions.required: Report the supported outcome for the post-cancellation charge: a $29.99 USD refund was issued per the authoritative billing record.
omissions.missing: The billing answer asserts the refund cannot be confirmed and requests transaction details, never conveying the recorded refund_issued outcome or the correct $29.99 amount.
